New plan: I got stuck in a loop between Playroom and Exercise room, repeatedly going north and then south. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to keep visiting the same rooms without exploring other possible directions. Next time, I will make sure to explore all possible directions from each room, and if I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead. I will also keep track of the rooms I have already visited to avoid revisiting them. 

To achieve this, I will add a new key to the graph dictionary to keep track of visited rooms, and I will check if a room is already visited before moving to it. If a room is already visited, I will choose a different direction. 

Here is an example of how the updated graph dictionary could look like:
{"action":"GO: DIRECTION", "graph": {"nodes":["Media room", "Exercise room", "Playroom", "Music room"], "edges":{"north":[("Exercise room", "Playroom")],"south":[],"east":[("Music room", "Playroom")],"west":[]}, "visited": ["Media room", "Exercise room", "Playroom", "Music room"]}}
